cause_quote: The diff removed `title=${selfLabel}` from the `sidebar-identity-card__name` span, taking away the full account name tooltip on hover.
user_saw: Long account, agent, and workspace names were clipped in the sidebar, and hovering over the labels left the clipped text hidden.
summary: The fix makes overflowing sidebar identity names fade at the clipped edge and scroll into view on hover or keyboard focus.
reasoning: The cited commit caused the account-name regression: its parent rendered the full name in `title` and installed the shared tooltip handler that displayed it on hover. The same fix also covers older clipping in the agent chip and workspace header, which shipped with static labels.
